title: 12 Best "Bar-hop through Matsumoto's Nawate Street, sampling local Nagano sake while admiring the snow-capped Alps and the iconic black castle."
description: Discover Matsumoto's vibrant nightlife! Bar-hop through Nawate Street and the castle district, sampling local Nagano sake, craft beer, and delicious izakaya fare.

places.name: Sake Bar Gen (酒BAR玄)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the master for a flight of recommended local sakes based on your preferences, paired with seasonal otsumami (snacks).

places.name: Kuragura (蔵久羅)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Shinshu Salmon Sashimi and a glass of Masumi sake. Their grilled dishes are also excellent.

places.name: Yamadai (山大)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assortment of Yakitori (grilled skewers) and a carafe of their house sake.

places.name: Matsumoto Brewery Taproom (松本ブルワリー タップルーム)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A flight of their seasonal craft beers. Their katsu sando is also a great accompaniment.

places.name: Fujiizumi (藤泉)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assorted Tempura platter and a bottle of Junmai Daiginjo sake.

places.name: Bar Take (バー竹)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Japanese highball or ask the bartender for a seasonal original cocktail.

places.name: Izakaya Shinjuku-ya (しんじゅくや)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous Karaage (Japanese fried chicken) and a large beer or sake by the carafe.

places.name: Daidaidokoro Yamabuki (橙厨房 山吹)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seasonal vegetable dishes and a recommended limited-edition sake. Their daily specials are always worth asking about.

places.name: Tsuchiya (土屋)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assortment of Oden (simmered dishes) and a hot sake (atsukan) on a chilly evening.

places.name: Bar Indigo (バーインディゴ)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic martini or one of their house special cocktails. Ask about their Japanese whisky selection.

places.name: Gozzensan (御膳水)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Assortment of fresh sashimi and a local dry sake, such as one from the Alps Masamune brewery.

places.name: Kura no Kura (蔵の蔵)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Robatayaki assortment (especially grilled local vegetables and fish) with a sake from a nearby brewery.
